name: survos/mercadolibre-php
description: Mercado Libre API client for PHP. Framework-agnostic -- usable from Symfony, WordPress, or plain PHP.

suggest.symfony/http-client: A PSR-compatible HttpClientInterface implementation; any implementation will do.
suggest.survos/marketplace-contracts: Provider-neutral listing models, if you want to target eBay and Mercado Libre through one interface.
